title: 第2512章 另有目的第2511章 刷我滴卡
slug: 给你玉女心经没让你用双修证道
content_zh:
不过这妞明知跟着老夫会有危险，还愿意跟在老夫身边，这勇气确实可嘉。
就是不知这妞只是口花花，还是另有目的。
两人在一起的时间满打满算也就三个时辰，双方还没深入了解，自己不能被她的花言巧语迷惑。
弄不好这妞知道自己只是孤家寡人一个，背刺自己也说不定。
如果这妞真这么做了，那她绝对是顶级戏子，小黄眼一直在关注这妞的表情包。
但凡这妞眼神流露出一丝狡诈之色，小黄眼便能捕捉到。
到现在系统也没提醒，说明这妞不是死心塌地对自己好，就是隐藏得很到位。
不管这妞到底有什么想法，以这妞的实力，即便暗算自己，也不能把老夫怎样。
现在灵火已经到手，两个小家伙都很满意，自己这个做大哥的也算对得起良心。
不过两个小家伙刚才的异常举动确实耐人寻味，先前小哥俩还一顿群魔乱舞。
看到这簇灵火出现，小青立刻怔住，舞也不跳了，只是呆呆看着那簇灵火。
询问其原因，小青提到那簇灵火即将突破，只要放在身边培养一段时间就行，小家伙还提到灵火给它带来一种异样的感觉。
小药渣询问什么感觉，小青却回答不出来，只是感觉很亲近。
小家伙现在找不到亲近的源头，可能因为灵火的品阶还不够。
自己头一次听到小青有培养灵火的想法，那可是火中恶魔，小魔头何时转性了。
这里面一定有什么说法，既然小魔头有这个想法，那便由着它，看它能弄出什么名堂来。
回到主席台的陈玲儿开始拍卖下一簇灵火，这簇灵火的竞争依旧很激烈，最终灵火以六十八万紫晶成交。
这次中拍的是显露六阶四层修为的小花，白秀秀再次折戟沉沙。
这妞已经气得咬牙切齿，怎奈囊中羞涩，只能任人欺凌。
白秀秀有心向黄夜求助，却张不开口，这妞可不想再次被拒，如果这小子真有那个心，肯定会主动开口。

这家伙一直默不作声，要么不想帮自己，要么就是他也没紫晶了，毕竟这家伙刚交付一笔巨量的紫晶。
看到二次出手的小花，这些六阶巅峰修士也看出这次竞拍有些蹊跷。
今天中拍这些修士不仅名不见经传，修为也不高，最不可思议的还是这些生面孔一个个出手阔绰。
故事发展到现在，也有个别修士后知后觉，他们认出有几个好像是上船没多久的那批修士。
这几人也不敢声张，如果这些人是同伙，他们当中可是有六阶巅峰修士，还有一个六阶后期修士。
这些人加起来足有十多个，这可不是几人能招惹的存在，本着多一事不如少一事的原则，几人通通当了缩头乌龟。
之后的灵火争夺，南宫雪和东方婷也参与进来。
二女再加上小萝莉和魔青花，把剩余的四簇五阶灵火全部收入囊中。
白秀秀只能无奈地叹气，没办法，自己已经尽力了。
这次来参拍的修士太猛，自己已经做了充足准备，还是没抢过他们。
这也是必然的结局，所有参与争夺的修士加起来也比不过众女的财力。
众女随便拎出一个，手里都有千万额度的聚宝钻卡。
为了掩人耳目，众女之间还发生争夺战，让拍卖方多挣了二十万紫晶。
content_en:
However, this girl knew that following me would be dangerous, but she was still willing to follow me. This courage is indeed commendable.
I just don’t know if this girl is just a show of love or if she has another purpose.
The time the two of them spent together was only three hours, and they hadn't gotten to know each other in depth yet, so he couldn't be fooled by her sweet words.
Maybe this girl knows that she is just a loner, and she might stab herself in the back.
If this girl really did this, then she is definitely a top actress, and her little yellow eyes have been paying attention to this girl's emoticons.
Whenever there is a hint of cunning in this girl's eyes, her little yellow eyes will be able to catch it.
The system hasn't reminded her yet, which means that this girl is either hell-bent on being good to her, or she's hiding it well.
No matter what this girl has in mind, with her strength, even if she plots against him, she can't do anything to me.
Now that the spiritual fire has been obtained, the two little guys are very satisfied. As the eldest brother, he can be considered worthy of his conscience.
However, the unusual behavior of the two little guys just now is indeed intriguing. Previously, the two little brothers were dancing around like a group of demons.
Seeing this cluster of spiritual fire appear, Xiao Qing was immediately stunned and stopped dancing. She just stared blankly at the cluster of spiritual fire.
Asked about the reason, Xiao Qing mentioned that the cluster of spiritual fire was about to break through, and it only needed to be cultivated for a period of time. The little guy also mentioned that the spiritual fire gave it a strange feeling.
Xiao Yaozhao asked what it felt like, but Xiao Qing couldn't answer. He just felt very close.
The little guy can't find the source of intimacy now, maybe because the level of the spiritual fire is not enough.
This was the first time I heard that Xiao Qing had the idea of ​​​​cultivating spiritual fire. It was a devil in the fire. When did the little devil change his gender?
There must be some explanation here. Since the little devil has this idea, let's let it go and see what tricks it can come up with.
Chen Ling'er, who returned to the rostrum, began to auction the next bunch of spirit fires. The competition for this bunch of spirit fires was still fierce. In the end, the spirit fire was sold for 680,000 amethysts.
The one that won the auction this time was Xiao Hua, who showed her sixth-level and fourth-level cultivation. Bai Xiuxiu failed again.
This girl was so angry that she was gnashing her teeth, but she had no money and could only let others bully her.
Bai Xiuxiu wanted to ask Huang Ye for help, but she couldn't open her mouth. This girl didn't want to be rejected again. If this kid really had that intention, he would definitely take the initiative to ask.
This guy has been silent, either because he doesn't want to help him, or he doesn't have any amethyst anymore. After all, this guy just delivered a huge amount of amethyst.
Seeing Xiaohua taking action for the second time, these sixth-order peak monks also noticed that there was something fishy about this bidding.
The monks photographed today are not only unknown, but also have low cultivation levels. The most incredible thing is that each of these new faces spends a lot of money.
As the story progressed, some monks realized it later, and they recognized a few monks who seemed to be from the group of monks who had just boarded the ship.
These people didn't dare to say anything. If these people were accomplices, there was a sixth-order peak monk among them, and a late-level sixth-order monk.
There were more than a dozen of these people in total, and this was not something that a few people could offend. Based on the principle that one thing more is worse than one thing less, a few people all fell into the trap.
In the subsequent battle for the spiritual fire, Nangong Xue and Dongfang Ting also participated.
The two girls, plus Little Loli and Mo Qinghua, collected all the remaining four clusters of fifth-level spiritual fires.
Bai Xiuxiu could only sigh helplessly. She had no choice but to do her best.
The monks who came to participate in the filming this time were too fierce. I had made sufficient preparations, but I still didn't overtake them.
This is also the inevitable outcome. All the monks participating in the fight combined cannot match the financial resources of the women.
The girls randomly picked up one of them, and they all had a treasure diamond card with a limit of tens of millions.
In order to cover up the public's eyes, a fight broke out among the girls, allowing the auctioneer to earn an extra 200,000 amethysts.
